note: The quietest way to make two honest derivers disagree: hand them the same (Task, Submission) pair and DIFFERENT revisions of the pinned profile. `requirementKeys` decides the tuple's key set, so a newer patch of the same profile URI that adds one key produces a different digest for identical execution. profiles §6.2 already forbids validating against a cached document whose digest differs from the pin; this fixture makes the derivation honor the same rule. A deriver that trusts whatever profile it was handed passes every other fixture in this kit and still forks the identity space in production.
